```{ojs}
Tabulator = require("tabulator-tables@5.5.0")
idb = require("idb@8/build/umd.js")
```

```{ojs}
// IDB initialization

db = idb.openDB("OutlierReviewDB", 1, {
  upgrade(db) {
    if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("reviews")) {
      db.createObjectStore("reviews", { keyPath: "identifier" });
    }
  }
})

// Helper to save or update an edited record
saveReview = async (record) => {
  if (!record || !record.identifier) return;
  const database = await db;
  await database.put("reviews", record);
}

// Helper to retrieve all saved records for CSV download
getAllSavedReviews = async () => {
  const database = await db;
  return await database.getAll("reviews");
}

// Helper to get saved state for a specific set of records
getSavedReviewsMap = async () => {
  const database = await db;
  const all = await database.getAll("reviews");
  return new Map(all.map(item => [item.identifier, item.status]));
}
```



### Outlier Review


```{ojs}
// Load data

// Imputation options
pce_outliers_log = FileAttachment("data/l2/logs/l2_pce_imputation_options.csv")
  .csv()
  .then(data => {
    return data.map(d => {
      let cleanedRow = {};

      for (let key in d) {
        let val = d[key];

        if (val === "" || val === "NA" || val === null || val === undefined) {
          cleanedRow[key] = null;
        }
        else if (key === "date" || isNaN(val) || isNaN(Number(val))) {
          cleanedRow[key] = val;
        }
        else {
          cleanedRow[key] = Number(val);
        }
      }

      if (!cleanedRow.status) {
        cleanedRow.status = null;
      }

      return cleanedRow;
    })
  })

// L1 PCE
pce = FileAttachment("data/l1/consolidated/l1_pce.csv")
  .csv()
  .then(data => {
    return data.map(d => {
      let cleanedRow = {};

      for (let key in d) {
        let val = d[key];

        if (val === "" || val === "NA" || val === null || val === undefined) {
          cleanedRow[key] = null;
        }
        else if (key === "date" || isNaN(val) || isNaN(Number(val))) {
          cleanedRow[key] = val;
        }
        else {
          cleanedRow[key] = Number(val);
        }
      }

      return cleanedRow;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
  })
```

strategyMap = new Map([

])

```{ojs}
// Filters

// Filter full time series data
filteredFullSeries = pce.filter(d =>
  d.sales_reporting_name === selectedCommunity
)

// Filter outliers based on imputation selection
imputedOutlierDots = outlierTableData.map(d => {
  const colName = strategyMap.get(d.status);
  const imputedVal = colName ? d[colName] : null;

  return {
    ...d,
    imputed_value: imputedVal
  };
})
```


```{ojs}
// Plot lines, outlier dots (red), and imputed preview dots (green)

Plot.plot({
  height: 500,
  width: 1600,
  marginLeft: 60,
  grid: false,
  x: {
    type: "utc",
    label: "Date",
    ticks: 20,
    tickFormat: "%Y"
  },
  y: {
    label: selectedColumn !== "All" ? selectedColumn : "Value",
    grid: true
  },
  marks: [
    // Timeseries line
    Plot.line(filteredFullSeries, {
      x: "date",
      y: d => d[selectedColumn],
      stroke: "#ccc",
      strokeWidth: 1.5
    }),

    // Timeseries dots
    Plot.dot(filteredFullSeries, {
      x: "date",
      y: d => d[selectedColumn],
      fill: "#888888",
      r: 3
    }),

    // Outlier dots (red)
    Plot.dot(outlierTableData, {
      x: "date",
      y: d => d.raw_value ?? d[selectedColumn],
      fill: "red",
      stroke: "black",
      strokeWidth: 1,
      r: 6,
      title: d => `Raw Outlier: ${d.raw_value ?? d[selectedColumn]}`
    }),

    // Selected imputation dots (green)
    Plot.dot(imputedOutlierDots.filter(d => d.imputed_value !== null), {
      x: "date",
      y: "imputed_value",
      fill: "#2ca02c",
      stroke: "black",
      strokeWidth: 1.5,
      r: 7
    }),

    Plot.tip(imputedOutlierDots.filter(d => d.imputed_value !== null), Plot.pointer({
        x: "date",
        y: "imputed_value",
        maxRadius: 10,
        channels: {
            "Community": "sales_reporting_name",
            "Year": "calendar_year",
            "Month": "calendar_month",
            "Imputed Value": "imputed_value"
        },
        format: {
            x: false,
            y: false
        }
    })),

    Plot.tip(filteredFullSeries, Plot.pointer({
        x: "date",
        y: d => d[selectedColumn],
        maxRadius: 10,
        channels: {
            "Community": "sales_reporting_name",
            "Year": "calendar_year",
            "Month": "calendar_month",
            [selectedColumn]: d => d[selectedColumn]
        },
        format: {
            x: false,
            y: false
        }
    }))
  ]
})
```


```{ojs}
// Tabulator Table with IDB Hydration & Persistence

viewof outlierTableData = {
  // get filtered raw records
  const initialData = pce_outliers_log.filter(d =>
    d.sales_reporting_name === selectedCommunity &&
    d.column_tested === selectedColumn
  );

  // hydrate status from IDB
  const savedMap = await getSavedReviewsMap();
  const hydratedData = initialData.map(row => {
    if (savedMap.has(row.identifier)) {
      return { ...row, status: savedMap.get(row.identifier) };
    }
    return row;
  });

  const container = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;"></div>`;

  const table = new Tabulator(container, {
    data: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(hydratedData)),
    layout: "fitDataFill",
    columns: [
      { title: "PCE ID", field: "project_code" },
      { title: "Name", field: "sales_reporting_name" },
      { title: "Year", field: "calendar_year" },
      { title: "Month", field: "calendar_month" },
      { title: "Column", field: "column_tested"},
      { title: "Orig Value", field: "raw_value" },
      { title: "Carry Fwd", field: "carry_forward" },
      { title: "Annual Avg", field: "annual_average" },
      { title: "Pre/Post Avg", field: "avg_preceding_proceeding" },
      { title: "Same Month Avg", field: "avg_same_month_other_years" },
      {
        title: "Override Action",
        field: "status",
        editor: "list",
        editorParams: {
          values: [
            "Keep original value",
            "Carry forward",
            "Annual average",
            "Average of preceding and proceeding months",
            "Average of months from other years",
            "Manual override: expert opinion"
          ]
        }
      }
    ]
  });

  // send changes to chart AND save row to IDB
  const updateData = async (cell) => {
    if (cell) {
      const rowData = cell.getRow().getData();
      await saveReview(rowData); // save edit immediately into IDB
    }
    container.value = table.getData();
    container.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
  };

  table.on("cellEdited", updateData);
  table.on("tableBuilt", () => updateData());

  container.value = hydratedData;
  return container;
}
```






```{ojs}
// Download Button

viewof downloadAction = Inputs.button("Download Saved Reviews (CSV)", {
  value: null,
  reduce: async () => {
    const savedRecords = await getAllSavedReviews();
    
    if (savedRecords.length === 0) {
      alert("No saved overrides found in local storage.");
      return;
    }

    // convert JSON records to CSV string
    const headers = Object.keys(savedRecords[0]).join(",");
    const rows = savedRecords.map(row => 
      Object.values(row).map(v => `"${v ?? ''}"`).join(",")
    );
    const csvContent = [headers, ...rows].join("\n");

    // trigger download
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", url);
    link.setAttribute("download", `outlier_reviews_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  }
})
```
